slices.focus: A lot has shifted lately, and I finally feel like I have something real to show
slices.summary: Rather than let political interference stall her corridor work, Monica rebuilds the protocol with clearer escalation triggers, a standard photo checklist, and a one-page chronic-offender brief designed to survive extra management review; she shifts from anger to design, accepting that the constrained version still protects urgent cases.
open_loops: Freeze protocol structure for trial period
Track urgent case age before and after rewrite
Get Andre's input on brief blind spots
decisions: Monica rebuilt her slowed corridor enforcement process around a formal chronic-offender brief and a standardized escalat
